closure_rule.statement: The shipped-surface enumeration is closed-world: every enumerated surface path must be covered by exactly one registry row, and every explicit covered path must be enumerated. A future asset added to the shipped surface without a new registry row (with its own recorded source and terms evidence) makes verification FAIL. Existing receipts clear nothing by existing: each row's verdict is bound to its own recorded evidence identity.
closure_rule.future_asset_duty: Adding, replacing, or upgrading any shipped asset/model/library requires: new row or updated row with (a) recorded identity (hash or pin), (b) recorded source citation, (c) recorded distribution-terms evidence (pin, on-disk hash, or banked dated snapshot). Receipts from other assets are not clearance.
